newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain calm on higher dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain calm on higher dollar.

text.p: The higher dollar kept a firm lid on activity on the European meals and feeds market this afternoon, market sources said.
Only a few trades were reported in old crop EU rapemeal and sunmeal.
"The stronger dollar and cautious expectations Chicago futures could ease after a few days of rising prices kept most buyers sidelined," one broker said.
June Eu rapemeal traded between 28.90 and 29.25 marks per 100 kg fob Lower Rhine and Spot EU sunmeal changed hands at 22.50 marks fob Amsterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
